definition: Evaluates a user-supplied, possibly vector-valued mathematical expression per pixel across one or more input rasters, producing an output raster with one or more bands.

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/raster-band-math-multiband to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-band-math-multiband, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-band-math-multiband/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

Withdrawal of the proposal (decision of 2026-11-19). The operation is the same as raster-band-math; only the number of bands of the output differed, a matter of signature already enforced by the dataType of each Implementation Profile's output. raster-band-math, whose definition now covers one or more output bands, replaces it (dct:isReplacedBy), and the Implementation Profile raster-band-math-multiband points there. Nothing is deleted; the item stays, unpublished. Classified substantive, the retirement of a type.
